introduction.text: The Monument to Pope John Paul II is a bronze statue in Rome that honors the late pontiff and stands near Termini Train station.

history.description: The monument was inaugurated on 18 May 2011.
After repairs, the statue was re‑inaugurated in 2012.

design.description: Designed by Oliviero Rainaldi, the bronze statue is titled Conversations: Homage to John Paul II.

art.description: The bronze sculpture features an open vestment that has been compared to a tent or bell.
